summary: Completed comprehensive testing of POS/Billing system. All 22 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI fully functional - POS page loads with category sidebar, menu grid, order panel. Full billing flow verified: order creation, item addition, KOT generation, bill generation with GST calculations.

issues: Console warnings about missing DialogTitle for accessibility - minor accessibility improvement needed

pos_page_load.details: POS Billing page loads with category sidebar (20+ categories), search input, menu grid, order panel

center_selection.details: Center dropdown works - PB-MGT (no items), PB-HSR (224 items), PB-PERTH (international)

billing_config_india.details: /api/billing/config/get returns 5% exclusive GST for India centers (PB-HSR), currency ₹

billing_config_australia.details: /api/billing/config/get returns 10% inclusive GST for Australia centers (PB-PERTH), currency $

menu_items_retrieval.details: /api/billing/menu returns 224 items for PB-HSR with name, category, price, is_veg fields

add_items_to_order.details: /api/billing/order/add-items adds items with correct qty and total calculations

update_item_quantity.details: /api/billing/order/update-item-qty updates qty and recalculates total correctly

cancel_order.details: /api/billing/order/cancel cancels order with reason, updates status to 'cancelled'

kot_generation.details: /api/billing/kot/generate creates KOT with KOT-{center}-{date}-{seq} format, only new items

kot_only_new_items.details: KOT correctly includes only items not yet sent to kitchen (kot_printed=false)

bill_preview_exclusive_gst.details: /api/billing/bill/preview calculates 5% exclusive GST correctly: subtotal=1000, GST=50, total=1050

bill_preview_inclusive_gst.details: For Perth 10% inclusive: item_total=110, subtotal=100 (110/1.10), GST=10, total=110

bill_generation.details: /api/billing/bill/generate creates bill with BILL-{center}-{date}-{seq}, marks order as 'billed'

payment_modes.details: Cash, UPI, Card payment modes supported and stored in bill

bill_void_admin.details: /api/billing/bill/void voids bill (admin only), updates bill and order status to 'void'

bills_list.details: /api/billing/bills/list returns bills with summary (total_sales, total_bills, void_count, by_payment)

frontend_item_click.details: Clicking menu item adds to order panel, shows toast notification

frontend_kot_button.details: KOT button generates KOT, shows print dialog with thermal format

frontend_bill_dialog.details: Generate Bill opens dialog with discount options, payment modes, customer info

frontend_receipt_dialog.details: Bill generation shows receipt with all details, print button

frontend_active_orders.details: Active Orders dialog shows orders with status badges (Active/KOT Sent)

critical_code_review_comments: billing.py correctly implements GST inclusive/exclusive calculations with proper formula
Sequence generation for ORD-, KOT-, BILL- prefixes uses atomic MongoDB operations
POSBilling.jsx has all required data-testid attributes for testing
KOT only includes items with kot_printed=false, preventing duplicate kitchen orders
Bill void requires admin access (is_super_admin or is_admin check)
context_for_next_testing_agent: POS/Billing system fully tested. Backend has 17 routes in /api/billing/* for config, menu, orders, KOT, bills. Frontend POSBilling.jsx is a full touchscreen POS UI with category sidebar, item grid, order panel. GST calculations verified for both India (5% exclusive) and Australia (10% inclusive). All CRUD operations working. Bill void requires admin access.
